title: M-Pesa: Mobile Money for the Unbanked
description: Learn M-Pesa: Mobile Money for the Unbanked in one minute.

hook.text: In Kenya, more people have mobile money accounts than traditional bank accounts.

buildup.text: M-Pesa launched in 2007, letting users send money via simple text messages on basic phones.

discovery.text: No smartphone or internet needed. A feature phone and cell signal are enough.

twist.text: M-Pesa lifted 2% of Kenyan households out of poverty by giving them access to finance.

climax.text: M-Pesa proved that mobile money can transform economies where banks don't reach.

punchline.text: A text message became a bank for millions.

quiz.question: What makes M-Pesa unique?
options: It works on basic phones without internet
It only works in the US
